title: Publish Windows research exports without hard links
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The committed-package exporter finishes a valid archive but fails at `os.link` in Windows environments that deny hard-link creation. Use a same-directory, non-overwriting `os.rename` on Windows and retain the POSIX link path. Cleanup handles the staging name being consumed by a successful rename.

Archive bytes, source selection, receipts and integrity checks are preserved. Five new regressions cover unavailable hard links, complete publication, a competing file or directory, publication errors and archive-close failure. This is a tooling repair with no mathematical or kappa claim.

## Task and overlap

Started from canonical main `3f0152a32eeebac0df11946dbd50cabe5a7f7839`; the pre-submission fetch returned the same commit. Task `portable-replay`, priority revision 8, seed `1c87352aa1fd006e0873d0e6c0a015b1`, scope key `831cc1a3c8f9ff01b197`. Scope is refined to one reproduced export-publication failure.

The [evidence note](https://github.com/josecarlosgonzalezroque-design/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8938e6be3e97ec3f2bfc0f7a32689919091eca67/docs/research/windows-export-publication.md) records exact source hashes, handoff/overlap checks and their partial coverage. Related #4579 repairs Windows fixtures; #5389 adds historical-input exports. This repair changes the final publication operation. #6165 and #5973 concern different JSON/stdout encoding boundaries.

## Validation

Native Windows 11 build 26300 / CPython 3.12.10 / Git 2.53.0.windows.3:

```sh
python -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_export*.py' -v
python -O -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_export*.py' -v
python -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py
git diff --check
```

Both suites pass **42 tests, zero skips**, within the restricted environment. The original suite had 12 failures at hard-link publication there; its direct-replay test passes outside the restriction. A separate real-Git comparison outside the restriction gives identical old/new archive bytes and receipts. Unsafe publication mutations are rejected. The selected binding-only baseline and diff check pass.

Published tree `93bfbc9c458990e1ba768898e8098396e9e34cf5` exactly matches the tested local tree. POSIX execution, other filesystems and scientific cold replays are unclaimed; hosted CI is separate.

## Credit

Credit Tekalign, Mihir Srivastava, roger-sato, Ali Romman, Douglas Colkitt and the retained exporter/replay lineage. Prepared for josecarlosgonzalezroque-design with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent, Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Corroborate the same suite on POSIX and another Windows interpreter. The evidence note gives the first step and platform limits.
